guardian.title: Consent from a parent or guardian
guardian.intro: You are under 18. Before we can read reports with AI, record voice notes or book treatment, a parent or legal guardian must give consent. Our team verifies the guardian before anything continues.
guardian.name: Guardian's full name
guardian.contactRequired: Give the guardian's email or phone number.
guardian.dobRequired: Pick the guardian's date of birth.
guardian.declaration: I am the parent or legal guardian of this patient, I am 18 or older, and I consent to the processing of their health data and to their treatment being arranged.
guardian.declarationRequired: The guardian must tick the declaration.
guardian.afterSubmit: We will contact the guardian to verify. You will be notified when it is done.
guardian.sent: Thank you. We will verify the guardian soon.
guardian.dobUnknown: Add your date of birth in your profile so we can check whether consent is needed.
guardian.statusHint: A guardian's consent is needed for patients under 18 before AI reading, voice notes or booking.

financing.title: Pay later with a partner
financing.description: Need longer to pay than our own instalment plan allows? These partners offer pay-later plans and loans on their own terms.
financing.disclaimer: Heal India Global does not lend money or make credit decisions. Pay-later plans and loans are offered by the partner, on the partner's terms, after their own checks. Our own instalment plans are interest-free and must be paid in full before your treatment date.

discharge.title: Discharge summaries
discharge.description: Your hospital's discharge summary: diagnosis, treatment, medicines and the warning signs to watch for at home.
discharge.emergencyNote: If you feel very unwell or notice a warning sign, contact a doctor or local emergency services straight away. Do not wait for a message.

list.emptyDescription: When your hospital finalizes your discharge summary, it appears here and we let you know.

detail.title: Discharge summary
detail.subtitle: {{hospital}} · case {{case}}
detail.notFound: This discharge summary was not found.
detail.fhirHint: The FHIR file is a standard format that your doctor's computer system can import.

detail.disclaimer: This summary was written by your treating hospital. Heal India Global does not change its medical content. Ask your doctor if anything is unclear.

sections.redFlags: Warning signs: get medical help straight away
